lessons.title: Recalling experience with ~던가
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 117 focus. Use the official Unit 5 page for the full explanation.

cards.translation: Did I read this book?
Was that restaurant delicious?
Did it rain yesterday?

lessons.title: Stating an experienced fact with ~더라
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 118 focus. Use the official Unit 5 page for the full explanation.

cards.translation: That movie was really interesting, I found.
Seoul was colder than I thought, I found.
That café had many people, I noticed.

lessons.title: Change or result with ~더니
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 119 focus. Use the official Unit 5 page for the full explanation.

cards.translation: It was cold in the morning, but became warm in the afternoon.
After studying hard, I passed the exam.
It rained, but now it is clear.

lessons.title: Surprise with ~다니
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 120 focus. Use the official Unit 5 page for the full explanation.

cards.translation: I am surprised that you went to Korea.

cards.prompt: 이렇게 늦게 온___ 믿을 수 없어요.
cards.translation: I cannot believe that you came this late.
It is amazing that that person won.

lessons.title: As time passes with ~다 보면
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 121 focus. Use the official Unit 5 page for the full explanation.

cards.translation: If you keep practicing every day, you will get better.
As you live in Korea, you will get used to it.
If you keep reading, you can understand it.

lessons.title: Unexpected result with ~다 보니
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 122 focus. Use the official Unit 5 page for the full explanation.

cards.translation: As I studied, it became late.
While walking, I found a pretty shop.
As I worked, I forgot my friend.

lessons.title: After trying with ~아/어 보니까
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 123 focus. Use the official Unit 5 page for the full explanation.

cards.translation: After trying it myself, I found it delicious.
After going to Korea, I found it really great.
After trying this method, I found it convenient.

lessons.title: Worth doing with ~ㄹ/을 만하다
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 124 focus. Use the official Unit 5 page for the full explanation.

cards.translation: This movie is worth watching.
cards.explanation: The target form is ~ㄹ/을 만하다, 가치가 있다.

cards.translation: This restaurant is worth going to again.
cards.explanation: The target form is ~ㄹ/을 만하다, 가치가 있다.

cards.translation: This book is worth reading.
cards.explanation: The target form is ~ㄹ/을 만하다, 가치가 있다.

lessons.title: Insisting with ~ㄴ/는다니까
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 125 focus. Use the official Unit 5 page for the full explanation.

cards.translation: I told you I am going!
I am telling you, it is really okay.
I said I did my homework!
